rule.scope: Persistent standards — always-on, file-scoped, or intelligently applied
rule.when: Constraints on HOW code is written (languages, frameworks, patterns, base policy)

skill.when: Methodologies the agent loads when a task matches (observability, performance, DDD, threat modeling)

command.antigravityTarget: ~/.gemini/config/skills/<name>/SKILL.md (global) or .agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md (project) — Antigravity has no /slash commands; personas are Skills
command.when: Persona switches and repeatable workflows (backend, PR review, architect)

base/global-rules.description: Celestial global base policy — domain-neutral engineering standards, WCAG, SonarQube gates, layering rules

skills/observability.description: Implements observability — structured logging, tracing, metrics, alerting, SLOs. Use when building or debugging monitoring, logs, traces, or on-call workflows.

skills/performance-tuning.description: Diagnoses and fixes performance issues — N+1 queries, caching, latency, throughput. Use when optimizing slow code, databases, or APIs.

skills/threat-modeling.description: Runs STRIDE-style threat modeling and security analysis. Use when designing features, reviewing security, or assessing attack surface.

skills/domain-driven-design.description: Applies DDD — bounded contexts, aggregates, domain events, ubiquitous language. Use when modeling domains or refactoring service boundaries.
